Some things happen every day. Some things only happen once a year. Either way, you'll want to know what's going on before you arrive — and what might bring you back.
Daily · 9:30 am & 5:00 pm

Daily Farm Feedings & Animal Snuggles

Twice a day, the barn opens up. No agenda, no ticket, no schedule to keep — just you and the animals doing what they do. It's the most popular thing we don't charge for. Pet, feed, and spend time with the whole crew: Highland cattle, goats, pigs, the donkey, chickens, and ducks.

Open to all overnight guests — no sign-up needed, just show up at the barn.

Good to know

Event questions, answered.

Still wondering? Call or text (803) 974-8585 — a real person answers.

It depends on the event. Our daily farm feedings are exclusively for overnight guests — no ticket needed, just show up at the barn at 9:30am or 5:00pm. Some events, like Goat Yoga and First Saturday farm mornings, are open to the community — guests and non-guests alike. Each event is clearly labeled on this page.

Daily farm feedings are included with your stay — no RSVP needed. Ticketed events like Goat Yoga require a ticket, clearly noted on each event card. We recommend booking early — popular events sell out.

Goat Yoga is $20 per person and is led by Flow with Hannah Rose on the first Saturdays of September, October, and November. It's open to both overnight guests and the public.

Yes — twice a day, every day, rain or shine. Morning feeding is at 9:30am, evening feeding at 5:00pm. Meet at the barn. Free with any overnight stay.

This page updates automatically as the team schedules new events, so it's always current.
